picks.editorial_note: AI was used to design entirely novel viral genomes not found in nature, prompting Georgetown ethicists to weigh in on dual-use biosecurity risk — a landmark moment for AI-bio convergence policy.
picks.title: AI Can Now Create Viruses. Should We Let It? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: A Brown mathematician is using AI to hunt for singularities in the Navier-Stokes equations, a 200-year-old open problem and Millennium Prize question — a striking example of AI advancing the frontier of pure mathematics.
picks.title: From the Lab: How Javier Gómez-Serrano is using AI to solve the most elusive question in math

picks.editorial_note: A $24.5 million NSF-funded effort to build a federated, AI-ready national data ecosystem represents major infrastructure investment that could underpin AI-driven research across many fields.
picks.title: Physics’ Coelho Lopes de Sa Joins $24.5 Million Effort to Create Unified, AI-Ready National Ecosystem | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: A University of Alabama-led team is building AI tools for the DOE's Genesis Mission, a national initiative to accelerate scientific discovery — signaling deepening federal investment in AI for physics research.
picks.title: UA Preview — Aug. 24-30, 2026

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's new neural network method compresses massive scientific datasets without losing critical detail, directly addressing a looming data storage crisis facing national labs and large-scale experiments.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo researchers built linked neural networks that can infer a semiconductor's internal defect state from a single sub-millisecond measurement, a potentially significant advance for chip manufacturing and diagnostics.
picks.title: Working backward from results: how can AI tell what is happening inside a semiconductor? | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo's new industry-academia cluster pairs a commercial AI drug-discovery platform with academic biomedical research capabilities, a concrete step toward AI-accelerated pharmaceutical development.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: An FSU economist's appointment as a Microsoft AI Economy Institute Senior Fellow, alongside CMU and Erasmus collaborators, reflects growing industry investment in rigorous research on how AI agents are reshaping hiring and labor markets.
picks.title: FSU economics professor studying AI’s impact on hiring as Microsoft AI Economy Institute Senior Fellow

picks.editorial_note: A $1.5 million NSF grant will fund a multi-institution effort to model large macromolecular systems over extended time scales using AI, advancing computational biology methods with broad downstream applications.
picks.title: $1.5 million NSF grant will support KU research modeling molecular systems using AI

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell's creation of a new Department of Systems and Computational Biomedicine, chaired by the pioneer of an AI-powered liquid biopsy for cancer detection, signals institutional commitment to AI-driven precision medicine.
picks.title: Dr. Dan Landau Named Inaugural Chair of the Department of Systems and Computational Biomedicine at Weill Cornell Medicine
